assessment: Finish the required labs in each module: the viz labs check the shelves, the chart and the values.
Pass each module quiz (70% or more). You can retry as often as you like.
Build the profit scatter, write the brief and pass the final assessment to finish the course.

faq.a: No. The viz builder runs in your browser and follows Tableau's logic and calculation syntax. Tableau Desktop is a desktop application; Tableau Public is a free version you can install to repeat the exercises, and the lessons describe the corresponding steps.

faq.q: Is the viz builder the real Tableau?
faq.a: No. It is a practice tool that follows Tableau's rules for dimensions, measures, shelves, aggregation, filters, quick table calculations and level-of-detail expressions, and says so when you use something it does not support, such as dual axes, maps, parameters or dashboards. The calculations you write use real Tableau syntax.

faq.q: What is explained but not practised hands-on?
faq.a: Dashboards and actions, stories, Tableau Prep, extracts, joins and relationships, publishing, permissions and row-level security. They need the desktop or server products, so they are covered with scenarios and sorting activities.
Comfort with a spreadsheet. SQL for Data & Business and Advanced Excel for Data Analysis in this category help but are not required.
Finishing every module and the final assessment marks the course complete on your GrowQR profile. It is not a Tableau certification.
